summary.en: Houthis have intensified missile and drone strikes against Saudi Arabia, hitting an airport, Saudi Aramco facilities, and a fuel depot, while Saudi air strikes have targeted Houthi sites in Yemen. Iran is accused of planning attacks on UK military sites, with MI5 warning of a shift toward harder targets and the UK sanctioning two Iranian nationals after an alleged IRGC plot at RAF Fairford. Iranian officials claim some incidents are false-flag operations in response to the UK accusations. The conflict now directly threatens Saudi oil infrastructure, regional air travel, and UK security, with 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
